reviews.text: Dr. Andy Nguyen and his team were so kind and gentle. So professional. So knowledgeable. We were in good hands getting my son's impacted wisdom teeth removed. I'm so grateful for their good work and warm dispositions. They were quick.
I have been taking my kids here for at least 12 years. The only front office person I can remember is the one still currently there, Clarissa. She is the most sweetest person.

Just had another great visit. Clarissa is seriously the sweetest and always makes me feel super comfortable. The place is spotless, which is a huge plus, and they're quick so I'm never stuck there all day.

Doctor Andy and his complete staff did an excellent job on my crown preparation. He was very gentle and I didn't feel pain during the anesthesia injection. He took time to explain the procedure. I highly recommend them.
Just a loving dentist office where I feel great. I've been visiting Doctor Andy's office — Andy, Clarissa, Dr. Sarah — they were all very great and nice. They treated me well.
The doctor knows how to work with my dental plan to give me results I love, and I am smiling again. I've been to several dentists before and this office is by far the best.
My Granddaughter loves going to Lumen Dental, the staff is so friendly. Dr. Aruna Sunesara and Clarissa are so good with the kids.
Lumen is the best Dentist I have found in Brazoria County. They take their time, they explain everything before they do it and they take really good care of you no matter what you go for.!
If I could give more stars, I would.. They are absolutely incredible. 10/10 recommend! Dr. Andy Nguyen, Dr. Aruna Sunesara, and Clarissa are truly amazing.

Dr. Andy, Clarissa, Mrs Nguyen, and Dr. Sunesara and the rest of the team truly make you feel welcome from the moment you step in. Great to have a dental office you can trust. We plan on coming back. Worth the drive!
We received high quality service in a patient friendly environment from professional caring doctors and staff. I definitely recommend LUMEN Dental to my friends and family.
My kids had an amazing experience at Gulf Coast dental Clarissa was the best and she was very helpful. No pain at all. I recommend this Dentist.
I’m always nervous about the dentist. Staff was very kind and friendly. Dentist was patient and had a lot of knowledge. Definitely will be going back.
Highly recommend. Clarissa is sweet and patient when we were asking questions. The staff and doctors are excellent. My daughter felt very comfortable. Thank you.
Lumen Dental has great and friendly people they will make you feel comfortable and relaxed and the service is fast but no rush. Great job guys 💪
everybody at this office were amazing people! i hadn't been to dentist in so long, but i felt right at home as soon as i walked in. i made a great choice going here and will continue to do so
They were great with my son. Very calming and informative too. We really liked them and will be going back.
My child is terrified of the dentist. He is only four but his experience with Dr. Andy was great. Dr. Andy comforted him.
They make you feel like family and are great with my kids.

We absolutely love this place very clean, professional, and informative. Dr. Pham is the best I've had 2 root canals she was so gentle and careful I left with little to no pain. 10/10 highly recommend
